organization.name_ja: 株式会社インターメスティック

affected.note: Ranked by the largest single figure published (92,426) because no overall total was given. Published figures in the final report of 2021-07-30: 92,426 Zoff newsletter subscribers, 757 Zoff EC customers and 3,728 GLASSAGE customers. Employee and some business partner data was also affected without counts. Credit card data was not included.

summary.en: Intermestic, operator of the eyewear chains Zoff and GLASSAGE, confirmed unauthorized access to its servers on 2021-05-10 and received an extortion message. Its final report said customer data such as names, email addresses and birthdates of about 97,000 people, plus employee and partner data, had leaked.
summary.ja: 眼鏡チェーン「Zoff」「GLASSAGE」を運営するインターメスティックは、2021年5月10日にサーバーへの不正アクセスを確認し、脅迫メッセージも受け取った。最終報告では、約9万7千人分の顧客の氏名、メールアドレス、生年月日などのほか、従業員や取引先の情報が外部に流出したとした。
